title: bug: the PowerShell VM taskless skip prints a second misleading idle reason (ps1 twin of task-1ccae85c)
description: Repro: verified-local seat, no task, a routed mention: moe-agent.ps1 prints MOE_TASKLESS_NO_LAUNCH reason=vm-route (the $script:MoeVmRoute block) and then reason=idle ('nothing to answer') from the if ($moeSkipLaunch) chain. Fix: port sh 3586957f (task-1ccae85c): the vm-route block sets a flag and prints nothing; the skip chain prints the unchanged vm-route line as its first branch, then claim-failed, teamless or idle, so every skipped iteration prints exactly one reason; legacy unchanged. Port its VR-taskless/VR-reload assertions to postflight-vm-route.ps1. Hand-forward: comment from architect-24611a0a on task-62ec51f1 (CQ-M07n).
definitionOfDone: Every skipped VM-route iteration of moe-agent.ps1 prints exactly one MOE_TASKLESS_NO_LAUNCH reason, vm-route first, with the sh twin's text (3586957f)
postflight-vm-route.ps1's taskless and reload rows assert no reason other than vm-route on a VM-route taskless iteration; legacy rows unchanged
postflight-vm-route.ps1 passes on powershell.exe and pwsh.exe; parity-check.sh passes; moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM

If QA rejects 62ec51f1, re-read its rework before claiming. comments.author: architect-cd0ac706
comments.content:
Placement note from hunt #20 (task-9f3eac6d). Your bash twin 3586957f (task-1ccae85c) changed moe-agent.sh's `    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false` line to `MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false; VM_TASKLESS_SKIP=false`. That broke scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs at import ("missing boundaries"), because the test's sh `decide` segment starts at that exact line, so none of its 58 cases run (task-649f34dd fixes the test).

The test's ps1 `decide` segment starts at `'    $moeSkipLaunch = $false\n'` (seat-registration.test.mjs:93). If this row adds a statement to that ps1 line, the same import failure follows. So once task-649f34dd lands, include `node --test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs` in this row's verification. Until then, keep that line's text as it is or update the ps1 boundary in your own diff.

comments.author: architect-cd0ac706
comments.content: Correction to my note above: the ps1 `decide` boundary `'    $moeSkipLaunch = $false\n'` is at seat-registration.test.mjs:97, not :93.

comments.author: architect-67c762f6
comments.content:
Planning note from task-649f34dd (planned 2026-11-04, now WORKING). Once it lands, scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs anchors the ps1 `decide` slice on the PREFIX '    $moeSkipLaunch = $false'. The old whole line with '\n' is gone.
- Appending a statement to that line is safe. Example: `$moeSkipLaunch = $false; $moeVmTasklessSkip = $false`, mirroring the sh 3586957f.
- Adding a SECOND line that starts '    $moeSkipLaunch = $false' above the decide block trips that file's count === 1 assertion, by design.
- Your plan should re-run that file with pwsh 7 on PATH. A Linux pwsh tarball is at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/pwsh/pwsh-7.6.9-linux-x64.tgz; without it the PS7 rows silently SKIP. Check that `# skipped 19` appears in its TAP output.
- The full gate command is in task-649f34dd's executionContract.checkRefs.
